items.title: Buddy Burns Interview, 1958-08-14
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Where did he come from? Aljaze, Aljaze. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, he came from Aljaze he did.

ctx.x: Jackson, yeah. Data Jackson. Data Jackson, yeah. He used to play bass fiddle too. At the time when I started playing, trying to play bass. He was playing string bass then, he wouldn't play in tuba. Is that right? Oh sure, he started playing tuba after, way after that. I didn't know. He did, yeah.
Where did he come from? Aljaze, Aljaze.

Yeah, he came from Aljaze he did. Yeah, he played bass fiddle. And then he got on that tuba way late after, maybe he might have, he fooled with bass there a good while, because I remember I was a kid, I couldn't play then, I was too young. But he was playing bass fiddle then, along with Liv Newton then. And then also, let's see how I recall his name, boy, oh I know all them old timers. Let's see here. Well.
